machineScope.reason: Single-machine supported installation (P-08): each file it writes is one machine-local control document (the runner's stop latch, the conversation holder, the doorway map, the credential registry), and an atomic replace discards the previous value.

Binary media is encrypted under the receiving journal root key and never deleted or replaced by media intake. New writes are refused at 8 MiB per file or 96 MiB encrypted store capacity; retained bytes are not pruned. Original intake and custody outcomes follow journal replication, but transferring secret-bearing blobs is not implemented. A takeover reports missing local media, never assumes the bytes followed the journal.

agreesWith.invariant: Every stored media outcome names an authenticated encrypted local blob with the recorded byte length. Readback verifies at admission; status and the existing hourly media-custody agreement report missing or corrupt custody without deleting or rewriting either store.
